_comment: DR backup config for the Studio->offsite-Mini topology. Pre-migration these run in LOCAL self-test mode (dest is a local staging dir). At migration, set 'dest' to the offsite Mini over the Cloudflare SSH tunnel, e.g. exomac@ssh.exosaero.space:/Users/exomac/dr-mirror/ and set dest_is_remote=true.
git_push_note: flip to true at migration once the Studio has the git remote + creds; pre-migration we don't want the mini pushing on a test
